candidates.sentence: Robert supports expanding job opportunities into all areas of Alabama’s 4th District through low taxes, reduced regulation, common-sense trade policies and strong immigration standards.

Robert believes that every life is a gift from God and should be celebrated, which is why he has participated in the March for Life, supported a ban on federal health coverage that includes abortion procedures, and fought against using taxpayer dollars to fund abortions both at home and abroad.
He will not rest until our country is free of abortion practices.
Robert is a staunch pro-lifer, conservative, and fights against the liberal’s cultural agenda.
He is working to cut taxes even more, slash regulation, and bring jobs back to our shores.
Robert believes in our Constitutional right to bear arms.
The Second Amendment protects the American people from government overreach and tyranny -- that must not be diminished.
Supports judges who uphold the Second Amendment
Robert is fighting to hold Russia and China accountable and bring jobs back to America.
Robert is fighting to hold Russia and China accountable.
China for its support of Russia and its threats to our allies and friendly nations in Asia.
Robert condemns Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and supported an additional $10 billion in arms and material to support Ukraine’s resistance.
He supports increased sanctions on Russian and it’s government officials and prominent individuals connected to Putin’s leadership.
Robert stands with Eastern European allies like Poland, Romania, Lithuania, Estonia and Latvia and supports increased US forces in those nations to deter Russian aggression.
